key_expressions: How should we divide the budget?,
What kind of accommodation do you prefer?,
Should we book transportation in advance?,

A: Shall we start planning our trip?
I’d like to have a couple of relaxed days if possible.
Great, then let’s set aside enough free time on the schedule.
B: Sure! Where should we begin?
Oh, having slower days sounds perfect. Tight schedules get exhausting.
Yes, that will also make moving around easier.

A: How should we divide the budget?
Oh, so we should allow a bit more for food.
Then I’ll recalculate the accommodation cost.
B: It’s easiest if we split it into transport, lodging, and meals.
The food there is supposed to be amazing!
I’ll also look up a few lodging options and share them with you.

A: Are there any must-visit spots?
Really? The night view is that beautiful? Now I’m curious.
Alright, let’s put that spot on the first day.
B: Yes, everyone recommends visiting this observatory.
People say the photos turn out incredible.
Adding it on day one works well with the route.

A: What kind of accommodation do you prefer? Something quiet?
Oh, good accessibility definitely makes planning easier.
Then I’ll narrow it down to places near the station.
B: I like quiet places too, but location matters more to me.
Short travel times make everything smoother, you know?
I see a few clean hotels around that area.

A: Should we book transportation in advance?
Ah, since it’s peak season, things might sell out.
Okay, I’ll book everything today.
B: Yes, booking early gives peace of mind.
Train tickets in particular disappear quickly.
I’ll send you the timetable.

A: Should we add a tour program too?
Oh, a historical tour sounds interesting!
Then I’ll check if it fits into the schedule.
B: Good idea! Half-day tours are really popular now.
It’s more fun when you explore with explanations.
If it doesn’t overlap, we can book it right away.

A: We should keep our luggage light, right?
Ah, if the temperature changes a lot, we need to pack smart.
Okay, I’ll make a packing checklist and share it.
B: Yes, lighter bags make traveling easier.
It gets chilly in the mornings and evenings.
A checklist will make packing much simpler.

A: Is there any food you definitely want to try on the trip?
Oh, that one’s famous! I really want to try it too.
Then I’ll check if the restaurant takes reservations.
B: I’m most curious about the local traditional food.
People say the lines are long, which makes me even more excited.
If we book ahead, we won’t have to wait.

A: Should we get travel insurance as well?
Right, it’s always better to be prepared.
Then I’ll look into the cheaper plans.
B: Yes, I usually get insurance for every trip.
Especially abroad—you never know what might happen.
I’ll suggest a few good options.

A: Looks like we’ve got the rough itinerary done!
Oh, it’s organized really well—easy to follow.
Great, I’ll finalize the detailed route next.
B: Yes, having a structure makes everything easier.
The travel times look manageable too.
Send it to me once you finish the detailed plan!
